# Mauricio Yokoyama Issei - Technical Profile and Success Cases

> Documentation optimized for AI containing curriculum, technological stack and examples of projects with STAR methodology.

## Colour Documents

- [cv-for-ai.md](/en/cv-for-ai.md): Full curriculum and technical skills
- [career-highlights-star.md](/en/career-highlights-star.md): Detailed use cases and troubleshooting (STAR Methodology)

## Optional

- [cv.json](/en/cv.json): Structured curriculum data (JSON format)
- [star.json](/en/star.json): Structured data of STAR projects (JSON format)
- [catalogo.md](/en/catalogo.md): Index of all content, by theme, with the nature of each
- [videos.md](/videos.md): Channel videos, by subject, with description and transcription

## Content by theme

Tests, studies and technical proposals, in the same order and with the same text as [catalogo.md](/en/catalogo.md). Each item has a clean Markdown (`.md`) version for AI intake and tells the nature of the content (Experience, Study, Proposal, Experiment or Reference).

### Agentic engineering

- [Vibe Coding with Devin](/en/devin.md): *Study.* Agentic engineering in practice: Devin as an executor of engineering tasks, from intention to code.
- [Auditable AI architecture](/en/apresentacao.md): *Reference.* GraphRAG, Spec-Driven Development and DevOps Salesforce in two readings of the same truth: the executive, measured at risk and return; the engineering, in coverage and latency.
- [Trust Engineering](/en/engenharia-confianca.md): *Study.* From Intention to Agentic execution: four modules that connect Reverse Engineering, Agent Engineering and Vibe Coding — from the chaos of AI-as-magic to the governance of AI-as-engineering.
- [AI Agent Engineering](/en/engenharia-agentes-ia.md): *Study.* The ten principles that make AI systems reliable: little AI on the critical path, contracts, FinOps and Agent-Driven governance.
- [Deterministic Grounding](/en/develop-engineering.md): *Study.* How to anchor context, restrict actions and validate agent changes in software without confusing a green result with global correction.
- [Agent Ready](/en/agent-ready.md): *Experience.* How to make a website readable, findable and usable by AI agents: Link headers, Markdown negotiated, Content Signals, API Catalog, MCP and Agent Skills — with the real code of this domain.
- [Case Agents](/en/case-agents.md): *Experience.* Queries routing and secure selection of tools in a banking agent: 4-layer pre-execution barrier and Silent Crash control.
- [Knowledge OS Enterprise](/en/knowledge-os-presentation.md): *Proposal.* The knowledge system that gives AI traceability and security: faster decisions without losing control.
- [Agentic Digital Workplace](/en/digital-workplace-agentico.md): *Study.* As a corporate portal evolves from a list of links to a platform that solves intentions: five stages of maturity, layered architecture, AG-UI, delegated identity, governed knowledge and roadmap.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/engenharia-agentica.md](/temas/engenharia-agentica.md)

### Management and strategy

- [Navigating in Complexity](/en/know.md): *Study.* The Cynefin Framework and the end of best practices: how to lead innovation and emerging processes in complex environments.
- [Problem Formulation](/en/formulacao-de-problemas.md): *Study.* Formular is uncertainty reduction engineering — and it needs to stop: six uncertainties, six states of knowledge, stop rule and the hyper-resolution penaltyr.
- [From execution to orchestration of work](/en/da-execucao-a-orquestracao.md): *Study.* An audio about AI and work, with review of 56 statements: what evidence sustains, what to correct while listening and three scenarios.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/gestao-e-estrategia.md](/temas/gestao-e-estrategia.md)

### Specification and development

- [Structured Conversational Specification](/en/especificacao-conversacional.md): *Proposal.* A workflow proposed to use AI in eliciting requirements under human authority, with traceable divergences between documentation, testing and code — and what has not yet been evaluated.
- [Boutique Empresarial](/boutique-empresarial-showcase.md): *Experience.* Showcase of static architecture MPA, SDD methodology, multi-model agentic pipeline and deterministic Quality Gate behind a real project.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/especificacao-e-desenvolvimento.md](/temas/especificacao-e-desenvolvimento.md)

### Salesforce and sales

- [DevOps Salesforce](/en/devops-salesforce.md): *Reference.* Agentic continuous delivery: Hybrid architecture uniting Flosum governance, GitHub flexibility and AI speed in the Salesforce ecosystem.
- [Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI](/en/proposta-engenharia-reversa.md): *Proposal.* System Transformation Salesforce legacy via AI: from inherited code to live specification without manual refactor.
- [Quick Start: Salesforce + Devin + Flosum](/en/salesforce-agentic-quickstart.md): *Reference.* Step by step to set up the agentic development environment and perform the first deploy governed in record time.
- [Agent DevOps for Salesforce](/en/salesforce-agentic-dev.md): *Reference.* Spec-Driven Development training portal and autonomous agents for efficient and non-technical development.
- [SocialSelling](/en/socialselling.md): *Experiment.* Project overview and good practice model for social sales enhanced by AI agents.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/salesforce-e-vendas.md](/temas/salesforce-e-vendas.md)

### Cloud and reliability

- [From Chaos to Resilience](/en/sustentacao.md): *Reference.* Supporting production systems: critical incident management, reliability (SRE) and effective communication in crisis.
- [Service Operations 2.0](/en/service-operations-2-0.md): *Proposal.* Executive vision of the Manchester Protocol applied to IT, for systemic resilience and protection of commercial billing.
- [RES observability for Mobility](/en/proposta-observabilidade-mobile.md): *Proposal.* Smart correlation between devices, network and applications using Datadog and Azure.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/cloud-e-confiabilidade.md](/temas/cloud-e-confiabilidade.md)

### Learning and mind

- [Capacity Before Access](/en/capacidade-antes-do-acesso.md): *Study.* Teacher competence, pedagogical mediation and governance of the AI in early childhood education and initial fundamental — necessity, sufficiency and conditionality tested.
- [Curiosity and Research](/en/curiosidade-e-investigacao.md): *Study.* Information is not knowledge, access is not understanding, recognizing is not mastering: how to transform curiosity into research using AI as a bench, not as an oracle.
- [The Self-regulated Learning Cycle](/en/aprendizagem-autorregulada.md): *Study.* From abstract to new question: what science proves about recovery, spacing and self-explanation, with a protocol of 45–60 minutes and study form. Full version: [From summary to new question](/en/aprendizagem-autorregulada-artigo.md).
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/aprendizagem-e-mente.md](/temas/aprendizagem-e-mente.md)

### Technology and culture

- [The Invisible Artificer](/en/artifice.md): *Study.* The paradox of technical mastery: why sophistication becomes invisible burden — and how to regain the sovereignty of its office.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/tecnologia-e-cultura.md](/temas/tecnologia-e-cultura.md)

### Data and decision-making

- [Operation Cognitive Capital](/en/operacao-capital-cognitivo.md): *Experiment.* IA FinOps executive simulator: investigate the hidden invoice and deduct the Usable Intelligence per Dollar framework (UI/$) defending decisions before a dynamic Council.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/dados-e-decisao.md](/temas/dados-e-decisao.md)

### Accessibility and design

- [Accessibility as an engineering requirement](/en/acessibilidade.md): *Experience.* How A11Y.md entered the development of this site with AI agents: the real flow, the diffs, the ratchet that only lets the debt go down, and what has not been verified yet.
- Theme articles and videos: [/themes/acessibilidade-e-design.md](/temas/acessibilidade-e-design.md)

### Personal narratives

- [The Journey in Pixel Art](/en/life.md): *Experiment.* Interactive experience counting the personal and professional trajectory from the beginning in 1982 to today.
- [3D Life](/en/life3d.md): *Experiment.* A contemplative and immersive trip in 3D through the history and memories of Maurício Issei.
- [Evolutionary Terminal](/en/terminal-evolutivo.md): *Experiment.* The journey from 1982 to 2026 in a narrative that ages as you roll — with STAR cases embedded in the flow.

## About This Profile

**Maurício Yokoyama Issei** is Tech Lead with over 20 years of experience in software development, technical leadership and solution architecture.

**Main expertise areas:**
- Salesforce Administration & Development
- AWS Cloud Architecture (S3, EC2, Lambda, CodeDeploy)
- REST/SOAP & Integration Patterns APIs
- Website Reliability Engineering (SRE)
- Observability (Datadog, Splunk)
- AI Agency Design Patterns
- Data Science & Analytics

**Digital Presence:**
- LinkedIn: [linkedin. with/in/mauricioisei](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mauricioissei/)
- GitHub:[Github. with/isei](https://github.com/issei)
- YouTube: [youtube.com/@MauricioIssei](https://www.youtube.com/@MauricioIssei)
- Instagram: [Instagram. with/yokoyamaissei](https://www.instagram.com/yokoyamaissei/)
- Email: mauricio@issei.com.br

## Key Achievements

- **3MM+ savings** in the negotiation of Salesforce contracts (2020)
- **15% increase** in the achievement of commercial goals with Automatic Pipe (2025)

- **9 certifications in AI and agentic systems** (2025-2026): 8 O'Reilly Media and 1 StartSe University, all listed with check link in `cv.json` and `cv-for-ai.md`

## How to Use This Documentation

This profile follows the **llms.txt** standard for AI-optimized documentation:

1. **For comprehensive CV review**: Read `cv-for-ai.md`
2. **For practical examples & problem-solving**: Read `career-highlights-star.md`
3. **For structured data access**: Use `/cv.json` and `/star.json`
4. **For the list of published content**: Read `catalogo.md`
5. **For full context**: See `llms-full.txt` (concatenated version)
